<!-- Source page: R-ryantm -->

[R. RyanTM](https://nix-community.org/update-bot/) is a bot that periodically tries to update ~all packages in <a href="Nixpkgs" class="wikilink" title="nixpkgs">nixpkgs</a>. If the update succeeds for a given package, it will open a PR and tag maintainers for review.

If you're wondering why your package isn't receiving update PRs, it can be useful to check the [logs](https://nixpkgs-update-logs.nix-community.org).
